hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
cd target
grep '^APPLICATION_CLIENT_SECRET=' /usr/local/docker-config/psama/psama.env | cut -d '=' -f 2- > secret.txt
export appplication_uuid=`docker run --rm -i -v $MYSQL_CONFIG_DIR/.my.cnf:/root/.my.cnf --network=${MYSQL_NETWORK:-host} mysql mysql -N -e "SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(uuid) FROM auth.application where name='PICSURE';"`
# This UUID is currently a magic number of sorts, this will need to be parameterized to make this job portable export new_token_introspection_token=`java -jar generateJwt.jar secret.txt sub "PSAMA_APPLICATION|${appplication_uuid}" 365 day | grep -v "Generating"`
# Rewrite the whole line rather than substituting on the OLD VALUE: a fresh install still holds the # __TOKEN_INTROSPECTION_TOKEN__ placeholder, and an absent/empty old value would make sed collapse to # "s//new/g" -- "no previous regexp", which fails this job and the whole Initial Configuration # Pipeline. '|' is a safe delimiter because a JWT is base64url (no '|'). TOKEN_KEY=TOKEN_INTROSPECTION_TOKEN
# gateway.env: add-or-replace. install-dependencies-docker.sh ships the key as a placeholder, but a # gateway.env generated by the deploy job on an upgraded install may not have the line at all. GATEWAY_ENV=/usr/local/docker-config/gateway/gateway.env if grep -q "^$TOKEN_KEY=" "$GATEWAY_ENV"; then sed -i "s|^$TOKEN_KEY=.*|$TOKEN_KEY=$new_token_introspection_token|" "$GATEWAY_ENV" else echo "$TOKEN_KEY=$new_token_introspection_token" >> "$GATEWAY_ENV" fi echo "gateway.env updated -- recreate the gateway container (Deploy or Start PIC-SURE) to apply."
# psama.env does not carry this key today. Replace it only if some deployment has added it; never # introduce it, so this stays a true no-op on a stock install. PSAMA_ENV=/usr/local/docker-config/psama/psama.env if grep -q "^$TOKEN_KEY=" "$PSAMA_ENV"; then sed -i "s|^$TOKEN_KEY=.*|$TOKEN_KEY=$new_token_introspection_token|" "$PSAMA_ENV" fi
docker run --rm -i -v $MYSQL_CONFIG_DIR/.my.cnf:/root/.my.cnf --network=${MYSQL_NETWORK:-host} mysql mysql -e \ "update application set token='$new_token_introspection_token';" auth
